# platform-orchestrator_pipeline_version (Resource) (RC)

Publishes one immutable reviewed pipeline draft revision. Does not allow or select it in project policy. Delete retires the publication and refuses while policy references it; remove references explicitly first. Use create_before_destroy when publishing a replacement, then move policy references before retirement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "platform-orchestrator_pipeline" "release" {
  project_id = "my-project"
  document = jsonencode({
    slug       = "direct-apply"
    name       = "Direct apply"
    definition = { strategy = "apply", steps = [] }
  })
}

resource "platform-orchestrator_pipeline_version" "release" {
  project_id                = "my-project"
  pipeline_id               = platform-orchestrator_pipeline.release.id
  expected_resource_version = platform-orchestrator_pipeline.release.resource_version
  request_key               = "reviewed-direct-apply-revision-1"

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

# Move policy references before retiring an old version.
# Review the draft and change request_key when publishing a different revision.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expected_resource_version` (Number) Exact reviewed draft revision. Server rejects stale publication.
- `pipeline_id` (String) Authoring draft UUID to publish.
- `project_id` (String)
- `request_key` (String) Stable caller-owned publication key (1-128 characters). Reuse for retries, change for a distinct publication intent. Scoped to authenticated actor and project.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Server-computed immutable recipe digest.
- `id` (String) Immutable published version UUID.
- `retired` (Boolean) Whether this immutable version has been retired. Retirement does not erase its history; choose a new reviewed draft revision and request key to replace it.
- `version` (Number) Published numeric version, distinct from draft resource_version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Supply the original caller-owned publication intent, not an invented revision/key.
# Core verifies project, version and authoring pipeline; GET cannot recover the key/revision.
terraform import platform-orchestrator_pipeline_version.release '{"project_id":"my-project","id":"PUBLISHED_VERSION_UUID","pipeline_id":"DRAFT_UUID","expected_resource_version":1,"request_key":"reviewed-direct-apply-revision-1"}'
```
